choices.A: The boundary point may correspond to two values
choices.B: The function must be undefined at the boundary point
choices.C: The formulas for the two pieces must be identical
choices.D: Which piece applies at this point and whether the function value is unique

question: What needs particular attention at a boundary point of a piecewise function?
solution: Check the endpoint conditions to determine which pieces apply. A boundary point in the domain must have a unique function value; if two pieces include it, their formulas must agree there. Therefore the answer is D.
